config.RealismMode.description: Adds a low chance to receive junk instead of the item you purchased, with a slightly convoluted way of getting a refund afterward.
TVShoppingNetwork.RealismMode.Junk.Name: Junk
TVShoppingNetwork.RealismMode.Junk.Descr: It fell apart the moment you picked it up. Better see if you can get a refund.
TVShoppingNetwork.RealismMode.Receipt.De: A fake receipt. Hopefully they won't inspect it too closely.
TVShoppingNetwork.RealismMode.SpecialOrd: The item you bought from the TV Shopping Network turned out to be junk! Get your money back, quick!
Send back the junk item via the shipping bin.
Send back the receipt...? You've lost it somewhere though. Maybe you can craft a fake receipt?
TVShoppingNetwork.RealismMode.RefundLett: To @,^^We would like to extend our sincerest apologies as the item you purchased does not meet our strict quality standards. We have issued you a refund for 80% of the item's original cost, as per our terms and conditions in compliance with Ferngill Republic Consumer Rights legislation.^^We hope that you will continue shopping with us in the future.
TVShoppingNetwork.ChannelText.Intro: Welcome to the TV Shopping Network, where you can have amazing deals from the convenience of your own home!
TVShoppingNetwork.ChannelText.Price: For today only, this amazing product can be yours for the low, low price of... {{ItemPrice}}g!
TVShoppingNetwork.ChannelText.SalesTalk: What a steal! Call the number on your screen now to secure your order! Don't wait! Stock is limited and incredible prices like this won't last long!
TVShoppingNetwork.ChannelText.Purchase: Would you like to buy the {{ItemName}}? This is a one-time offer.
TVShoppingNetwork.ChannelText.Purchase.T: Thank you for your purchase! Your item will be mailed to you tomorrow.
TVShoppingNetwork.ChannelText.Purchase.N: Sorry, but you don't have enough for that. Join us again next week.
TVShoppingNetwork.ChannelText.SoldOut: All of our items for today have been sold. Join us again next week for more special offers!

TVShoppingNetwork.ChannelText.ItemDescri: Twenty hardwood fences! Made from 100% all-natural hardwood, these sturdy fences have a rugged charm and are guaranteed to last for over 500 days!
Ten quality sprinklers! Take the work out of your workday with these high-tech sprinklers that water DOUBLE the area of a standard sprinkler!
Five iridium sprinklers! Utilizing iridium fittings and the latest technology in water dispersion, these sprinklers will cover six times the area of a standard sprinkler!

A cheese and mayo machine bundle! This bundle includes 2 cheese presses and 2 mayonnaise machines so you can easily get started with making your own homemade artisan goods! Luscious cheese and silky mayonnaise will soon be yours!
A fish smoker! Requiring 50% less coal than other brands (*coal sold separately), this home smoker opens up all-new rustic flavor possibilities!

A dehydrator! Found yourself with too much fruit after your summer harvests and not enough ways to use it? Turn it into delicious and nutritious dried fruit snacks with this incredible device! Compatible with all fruits!
Five casks! Turn even the most average of beers, wines, and cheeses into the finest quality products with this easy-to-use home-ageing kit!

A preserves jars and kegs bundle! This bundle includes 2 preserves jars and 2 kegs so you can easily get started with making your own homemade artisan goods! Tart pickles, tangy jellies, fresh juices, and smooth wines will soon be yours!
Twenty boxes of quality fertilizer! Think your garden or farm could use a little pick-me-up? Give it the best today with this amazing fertilizer deal!
Ten boxes of deluxe fertilizer! This fantastic mix of vital minerals and nutrients is everything your garden or farm needs for the best-quality produce!

Five boxes of tree fertilizer! Dreaming of luscious forests, but all you can grow is sad spindly saplings? Try this deluxe tree fertilizer, guaranteed* to speed up wild tree growth! (not guaranteed for select varieties)

A wild seeds bundle! Even the most un-green of thumbs can easily grow fresh tasty forage with this seasonal wild seeds bundle, which includes 5 wild spring seeds, 5 wild summer seeds, 5 wild fall seeds, and 5 wild winter seeds. Order now and we'll throw in 5 mixed seeds entirely free!

Five blue grass starters! Treat the animals on your farm like royalty with this deliciously healthy grass! It fulfills all their nutritional needs, keeps them full longer, AND boosts their mood! It doesn't get any better than that!
A mystic tree seed! With this rare seed, you too can grow your very own Bluemire Mystic tree, known for its magical syrup!
Three mahogany tree seeds! Produce your very own high-quality hardwood with these premium seeds, guaranteed to reach full maturity within 55 days!

A fishing tackle bundle! For the avid angler in your life, this quality gift bundle includes 1 dressed spinner, 1 cork bobber, 1 treasure hunter lure, and 1 lead bobber so they can handle even the heftiest of lunkers!

A curiosity lure! Are you an angler who just keeps missing the catch of a lifetime? Does that rare fish keep evading you no matter how long you wait? With this curiosity lure, fishing frustration will be a thing of the past!
Five magic baits! No more waiting for that one fish which only comes out at 2AM - with this miraculous bait, you can relax and catch whatever you want whenever you want!

Three challenge baits! Has fishing lost its shine? Does the thrill of the catch no longer entice you? With this challenge bait, bring back the spark and challenge yourself to catching three fish at once! Yes, you heard that right!

Five crab pots! Made from sturdy stainless steel and weather-treated wood, these premium crab pots can hold any crustacean with ease! Just load them up with your bait* of choice (bait not included) and you'll be having fresh lobster dinner before you know it!

An iridium band! It glows, it attracts items, it makes your attacks stronger - what CAN'T it do?! This incredible ring is a must-have for any adventurer no matter whether you've fought one monster or a thousand!

Three life elixirs! Found yourself more than a little beaten up after fighting monsters in your adventurous location of choice? Worked out too hard at the gym and pulled a muscle or three? These extraordinary potions will have you feeling 100% again in no time!

Three pouches of fairy dust! Made from 100% natural ingredients, this magical powder will instantly speed up ANY* mechanical process, allowing you to immediately reap the rewards of your hard work! (*the TV Shopping Network takes no responsibility for anomalies caused by usage on living beings)

A warp totem bundle! In a hurry with no time to lose? Got important business to take care of that just can't wait? Get where you need to go instantly with these convenient totems! Includes 1 farm totem, 1 mountain totem, 1 beach totem, and 1 desert totem - call now and we'll include 1 island totem FREE!

Three treasure totems! A must-have for the avid treasure-hunter, these mysterious totems can magically draw up hidden treasures from deep underground to the surface, saving you valuable time and energy!

A crystalarium! Work smarter, not harder, by using the latest in crystal matrix replication technology to replicate any jewel or mineral! No more long days sweating away in the mines hoping for just one diamond!
A heavy furnace! Why keep using your old worn-out furnace when you could instead be using this new and improved model that works up to 45% more efficiently compared to competing brands?
A solar panel! Don't waste time waiting on fickle thunderstorms when you could instead be using clean and reliable solar power for all your battery needs!

Three heavy tappers! Got a hankering for pancakes with fresh-from-the-tree maple syrup whenever you like? These upgraded models are twice as efficient as standard tappers, providing you with syrup, tar, and resin faster than ever!

A deluxe worm bin! Featuring a sturdy design, quality aeration, and high-grade compost, this worm bin is self-sufficient and non-aromatic, producing deluxe bait without any of the smell! Order now and get 200 earthworms FREE!

Two mushroom logs! Perfect for the person who loves the outdoors but doesn't have time to forage in the wilderness, these mushroom logs will be sprouting all over with new 'shrooms before you know it!

A bait maker! Sick of reeling in sardines when all you want is a tuna? Then this is the machine for you! Simply add your fish of choice to the bait maker and voila, in only 10 minutes it'll produce bait specially tailored to catch whatever you're looking for!

Three chests! Are you tired of digging through boxes to find wherever your tools have ended up? Sick of trying to find just where you put that thing you need? Organise your life with this handy bulk deal!
A big stone chest! This chest holds DOUBLE the amount of items as a regular chest, and what's more, the fine granite finish adds a sense of gravitas and formality to any room!

A sign bundle! Do you love keeping things organised and labelling your belongings? If you do, then this bundle is for you! It includes 3 wooden signs, 3 stone signs, 3 dark signs, and 3 text signs, sure to suit even the fussiest of organisers!

Two garden pots! Why leave your beloved plants to the whims of the outdoors? Bring them inside where you know they'll be protected with these fine terracotta garden pots! Featuring drainage holes and easy maneuverability, these pots can accomodate any* type of plant in any indoor location!

Three scarecrows! No time to manually scare away pesky birds that want to take off with your hard-earned crops? Let our scarecrows do the work for you! Guaranteed to keep crows and other pests at bay with our lifelike designs!

A camping bundle! Featuring 3 cookout kits and 3 tent kits, this bundle is the perfect present for the outdoor adventurer in your life. Give them the gift of getting away from civilisation in style this summer!
A tapper products bundle! Perfect for the DIY enthusiast in your life, this bundle includes 3 bottles of oak resin, 3 bottles of pine tar, and 3 bottles of maple syrup!
A spring fruit bundle! Missing the sweet taste of spring? Bring it back with this gift basket of 3 apricots and 3 cherries!
A summer fruit bundle! What could be a better gift than the refreshing taste of summer? Say 'the summer will never end' with this gift basket of 3 oranges and 3 peaches!
A fall fruit bundle! Does anything compare to the crisp taste of fall? Relive the days of changing leaves and cool breezes with this gift basket of 3 apples and 3 pomegranates!
A tropical fruit bundle! Nothing says vacation like the passionate taste of far-off tropical islands! Have a weekend getaway with this gift basket of 3 mangoes and 3 pineapples!
Four mahogany chairs! Always caught off-guard by unexpected guests? Entertain in style with this elegant 4-piece dining chair set!
A woodsy couch! Featuring a heartwarming combination of warm carved woods and energetic leaf-patterned green cushions, this couch brings the outdoors indoors with style!
Two brown armchairs! Ready for rest after a hard day of honest work? Put your feet up in comfort with these ultra-plush armchairs! You'll never want to get up!
A desert table! Bring the flavor of Calico Desert into your home with this mahogany dining table, carved with lavish geometric designs!
A wizard table! Add a touch of the mystical to your home with this avant-garde octagonal table, inlaid with magical symbols! It's sure to enchant your guests!
Two walnut end tables with lamps! No need to buy lamps separately with these sturdy end tables! Perfect for putting your feet up at the end of the day and relaxing with a good book!

Two grandmother end tables! Build a home that says 'baking cookies at Grandma's' with these comforting end tables! Each one comes with its own full-length table cloth, guaranteed to help prevent spills and stains!

A junimo tea table! With a design inspired by the mythical forest spirits, this low table is perfect for sharing tea with a friend! Order now and you'll receive TWO free handleless tea mugs from our Ju-Nii range!
A luxury bookcase! Running out of space for all your books? Got a booklover who's just starting their collection? Bring wit AND class into your home with this elegant mahogany bookcase!
A large wizard bookcase! Make your home feel like a wizard's tower with this incredible floor-to-ceiling bookcase! Perfect for all your tomes, grimoires, and fantasy romance novels!
An oak dresser! Tired of storing your clothes in flimsy boxes or unstylish chests? Keep your apparel in perfect condition with this timeless classic!
A retro fireplace! This brick fireplace will warm your home AND your heart with its vintage appeal! Comes with two FREE mantelpiece decorations!
A bundle of three small rugs! Say goodbye to cold floors and hello to comfort your feet will love with this bundle of three small rugs! Includes 1 mystic rug, 1 snowy rug, and 1 light green rug!
A funky rug! Got a hankering for those retro arcade vibes? Bring back the disco era with this purple rug printed with neon geometric designs!
A starry moon rug! Delight the little astronaut or astronomy enthusiast in your life with this glimmering blue and gold rug!

A bundle of six small cushions! Add a touch of whimsy and comfort to your home with this collection of small cushions*, perfect for decorating or for seating! (*cushion designs are selected at random and TV Shopping Network cannot guarantee specific designs.)
Four wall sconces! Bring light into your home without compromising on design! These wall sconces are designed to be unobtrusive and provide a warm light without taking up additional space!
Two country lamps! Featuring vintage cream lampshades and a sculpted wood post, these lamps will bring that classic country charm faster than you can say 'bless your heart'!

A plasma TV! Upgrade your old CRT TV and see every detail with this amazing high-definition plasma screen! Using the latest in digital technology, this television offers brighter colours, higher contrast, and details that leap into your living room!
A strawberry double bed! Wish yourself a good night and sweet dreams with this plush double bed, complete with a full set of cozy picnic-inspired red gingham bedding!
A birch double bed! Sleep like a princess in this elegant pastel bed, featuring pale peach sheets and a carved bedhead inlaid with mother-of-pearl detailing!

A bundle of five small houseplants! Spruce up your home and add a touch of green with these easy-to-care-for artificial houseplants! Just give them a dust every now and then and they'll happily decorate your home for years to come! (*designs may vary from model displayed).

A exotic tree! Love a green touch about the house but think that regular houseplants are a little too conventional? Make a statement with this artificial rainforest fig tree, complete with decorative shallow pot!

Two fancy houseplants! Show that your decorating tastes are a step above the rest with these ritzy contemporary houseplants, guaranteed to wow your guests!

Bring home one of these limited print runs for 'Clouds', Lupini's jawdropping original! Order now and you'll also receive TWO matching banners entirely free!

Five enrichers! These incredible upgrades attach flawlessly onto ANY sprinkler and automatically mix any provided fertilizer as they water, saving you time and energy!

A decorative sword! Whether you're a weapons fanatic or an adventurer looking to show off your spoils, this beautifully-embellished longsword complete with glass display cabinet will be a talking point in any home!

A butterfly hutch! This beautiful vivarium comes with everything you need to attract butterflies, including a variety of butterfly-friendly flowers and plants! Simply place it indoors and you'll have butterflies fluttering about in no time!
An upright piano! Wow your guests with this elegant and timeless instrument that comes pre-tuned for perfect sound every time! Order now and receive a FREE book of piano sheet music!

Two elegant vases! Wanting to enhance your home's appeal? What could be better than these classy decorative vases? Place them together as a matched pair or individually to catch the eye with their striking tigerseye-inspired design!
A copy of Book of Mysteries! This mysterious text is an essential buy for mystery box enthusiasts, providing hundreds of theories and tips to help you acquire more!

A copy of Treasure Appraisal Guide! Learn to sort the fake from the fabulous! The essential book for antique hunters and amateur archeologists, this guide contains expert advice for evaluating thousands of items!
